title: Critique: the apical mechanism appears late in development and evolution

statements.text: Apical amplification arises late in both phylogenetic and ontogenetic development and has not been found in hippocampus, olfactory cortex or subcortical regions. Tying consciousness to it would deny consciousness to infants and to species without a neocortex, unless different forms of consciousness are distinguished.
